tasks.title: Rename an API token
tasks.prompt:
Settings → API tokens is getting a Rename action. Wire up the data layer for it in `@flama/frontend-consumer`:

- `ApiTokensService.rename(id: string, name: string): Promise<ApiTokenEntity>`. The API is `PATCH /api/v1/tokens/{id}` with a `{ name }` body, and it answers with the renamed token.
- A `useRenameApiToken(options?)` hook exported from `@flama/frontend-consumer/react`. Its variables are `{ id, name }`. The rename dialog will pass its own `onSuccess` to close itself and show a toast, and the token list must show the new name straight after.

No UI in this change.
